name: complex
description: Demo database for complex types (ARRAY, OBJECT, MAP, VARIANT, nested to any depth) in Snowflake. The dialectType carries the full structured spelling; the typeFamily is the family of the root. Untyped ARRAY and OBJECT columns carry no element types and are not part of this bed.

columns.name: nr
columns.label: Nr
columns.description: Row identifier (primary key)

columns.name: tags
columns.label: Tags
columns.description: List of text values; elements are addressed 1-based

columns.name: scores
columns.label: Scores
columns.description: List of integers; numeric elements for lambda arithmetic

columns.name: vec
columns.label: Vector
columns.description: List of three doubles; Snowflake has no fixed-size array

columns.name: matrix
columns.label: Matrix
columns.description: List of two lists of three doubles; the first index selects the row

columns.name: dims
columns.label: Dimensions
columns.description: Flat structure (OBJECT) of width and height

columns.name: address
columns.label: Address
columns.description: Structure (OBJECT) holding a nested structure (geo) and a list (phones)
columns.dialectType: OBJECT(street VARCHAR, geo OBJECT(lat DOUBLE, lon DOUBLE), phones ARRAY(VARCHAR))

columns.name: attrs
columns.label: Attributes
columns.description: Map from text keys to text values

columns.name: counts
columns.label: Counts
columns.description: Map from text keys to integer values

columns.name: lookup
columns.label: Lookup
columns.description: Map with integer keys: a numeric selector is a key here, a position in a list

columns.name: items
columns.label: Items
columns.description: List of order-line-like structures: sku, quantity, price and a list of options
columns.dialectType: ARRAY(OBJECT(sku VARCHAR, qty INTEGER, price NUMBER(10,2), opts ARRAY(VARCHAR)))

columns.name: events
columns.label: Events
columns.description: List of structures with temporal fields

columns.name: deep
columns.label: Deep
columns.description: Four levels: a list of maps whose values are structures holding a list and a map of lists
columns.dialectType: ARRAY(MAP(VARCHAR, OBJECT(a ARRAY(INTEGER), b MAP(INTEGER, ARRAY(VARCHAR)))))

columns.name: doc
columns.label: Document
columns.description: VARIANT document; paths and array indexes count from 0

columns.name: odd
columns.label: Odd
columns.description: Structure (OBJECT) with a mixed-case field name that needs quoting
